messages:
Marta (networking): quick follow-up from the ENI prototype: we need a clear lease + jittered renewal contract to stop flapping and make failover deterministic.
Eli (infra): agreed. current behaviour flips immediately on a single missed ping which causes cascading handoffs. propose 3-step state machine: attaching -> active -> renewing.
Noor (security): important: leases must be short-lived and fully auditable. prefer 90s TTL, renew at 30s +/- jitter. revocation should force immediate role invalidation and shift to relay.
Jon (product): customers asked for explicit UI states: "ENI active", "ENI attaching", "ENI degraded (using relay)" and a one-click failover to relay. show last failover reason.
Marta (networking): concrete contract suggestion:
- lease_ttl = 90s
- renew_at = ttl/3 with random +/- 8s jitter
- miss_count threshold = 2 (i.e., two missed renews => degraded)
- route_ttl = 30s
This keeps failover window ~45-60s in worst case.
Eli (infra): add attach grace: if an ENI attach started but hasn't completed in 12s, keep endpoint in "attaching" for up to 30s before failing to relay. avoids failing on transient cloud API delays.
Noor (security): audit entries required for: lease_grant, lease_renew, lease_revoke, attach_request, attach_complete, manual_failover. retention >= 180d. also require customers to opt-in explicitly for ENI-strict mode.
Jon (product): billing copy: surface estimated egress per-month for ENI vs relay, show warm-pool cost if they enable pre-warmed ENIs. include an "expected latency improvement" blurb.
Marta (networking): header propagation: when ENI path active set X-Redwood-Path: eni and preserve X-Forwarded-For. when relay active set X-Redwood-Path: relay and include X-Original-Client (if available). always set X-Redwood-Request-Id.
Eli (infra): telemetry requirements: lease_issued_total, lease_renew_failures, attach_time_ms, attach_failures_total, handoff_count, active_path_gauge. alert if lease_renew_failures_rate > 0.2% over 10m.
Noor (security): handshake flow should use AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity + short-lived session creds. control plane issues short-lived signed lease token which the agent exchanges for STS credentials. no long-lived keys stored anywhere.
Marta (networking): rollout plan: beta with 4 low-risk customers, enable warm-pool opt-in for bursty workloads, measure handoffs and p99 for 2 weeks. GA after stability and docs.
ops-bot: ticket ARCH-4900 created: "lease-jitter-failover-contract + telemetry + onboarding docs" assigned to @Marta and @Eli.
Jon (product): i'll draft the UI states + onboarding checklist and link pricing options.
Marta (networking): i'll draft the RFC with the state machine diagram and a short terraform snippet for opt-in. ping me for review tomorrow.
